title: Prove closure and re-freeze without repeat findings
description:
Phase 3. Migrate the full corpus through the clause model, add permanent
regression evidence for every finding, and pass an independent no-repeat review
before re-freeze.

Only after this epic closes may eshyra-o9bd.14 (regenerate + re-freeze) and
eshyra-2zyy (restore SRD thaw-note CI gating) proceed.
acceptance_criteria:
- The full corpus is migrated and reclassified, with exact memberships reconciled rather than sampled.
- Every finding has a checked-in registry row and a committed regression predicate.
- Independent max-level reviews report zero repeat findings.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
